display_long_description:
Quartet VR places you at the center of a live string quartet performance—two violins, a viola, and a cello—captured in cinematic 4K 360° video with spatially-anchored ambisonic audio. Watch, listen, and interact in a uniquely immersive music experience.

🎻 Immersive Concert Environment
Feel like you’re really there as four musicians perform around you in an elegant concert setting.

🎧 Spatial Audio with Focus Mode
Gaze at a player to bring their instrument forward in the mix—automatically isolating and enhancing their sound. Look away to return to the full ensemble.

🕹️ Manual Audio Mixing
Use your controller to manually solo one or more instruments and explore the texture of the performance your way.

🎼 Movement Selection
Switch between different musical movements with an intuitive in-app menu.

⏯ Pause and Resume Playback
Control the experience with easy in-app playback controls.

📘 Guided Tutorial
Start with a simple tutorial that introduces you to the features and controls in a digital environment.

Whether you're a fan of classical music or simply curious about immersive sound, Quartet VR is a one-of-a-kind virtual concert designed for music lovers of all kinds.
